Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIX.4.2. Must be the first field in message.

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Must be second field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Must be the third field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Message sequence number. Reset to 1 at the beginning of each session.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: SenderCompID as assigned by NASDAQ OMX PSX. The maximum size is 4 to 6 characters.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: TargetCompID as assigned by NASDAQ OMX PSX. The maximum size is 4 to 6 characters.

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: Required by FIX but not validated by NASDAQ OMX PSX.

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: Ignored. When sending execution report NASDAQ OMX PSX will send INET in this field.

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Ignored, When sending execution report NASDAQ OMX PSX will duplicate first 4 characters of Client Order Id in this field.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Should be present on retransmitted messages, whether prompted by the sending system or as the result of a resend request.

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Required when message may be duplicate of another message sent under a different sequence number.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: Required for message resends but not validated by NASDAQ OMX PSX.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Modulo 256 checksum of all characters in message up to and including the delimiter preceding the CheckSum field. Three digits with leading zeroes if necessary.

Message.Name: Heartbeat
Message.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 session message. Sent if the agreed upon HeartbeatInterval has elapsed since the last message sent; not needed if any message has been sent during the preceding HeartbeatInterval. NASDAQ OMX PSX replies with a Heartbeat to a Test Request, providing TestReqId as of the original Test Request.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Required when the heartbeat is the result of a Test Request message. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Message.Name: TestRequest
Message.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 session message. NASDAQ OMX PSX will issue a Test Request if HeartbeatInterval + 1 seconds have elapsed since the last message received; if 3 consecutive Test Requests go by without receiving a message the TCP connection is considered broken and will be dropped.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Identifier included in the Test Request message to be returned in the resulting Heartbeat. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Message.Name: ResendRequest
Message.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 session message. An open (EndSeqNo zero) or closed sequence range may be requested; NASDAQ OMX PSX will honor either type. Any messages sent in response to a NASDAQ OMX PSX Resend Request should have PossDup = Y.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNo
Field.Description: Message sequence number of first message in range to be resent. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: EndSeqNo
Field.Description: Message sequence number of last message in range to be resent; zero for an open range. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Message.Name: Reject
Message.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 session message. Session level rejects indicate violations of the session protocol, or missing (or invalid) fields; expected during development and certification but extremely rare in production.

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum of rejected message. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: RefTagID
Field.Description: The tag number of the FIX field being referenced. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: The MsgType of the FIX message being referenced. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: SessionRejectReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for a session-level Reject message. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Where possible, message to explain reason for rejection. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Message.Name: SequenceReset
Message.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 session message. Gap Fill (GapFillFlag = Y) messages conform to standard message sequencing rules; sequence numbers in the past are ignored and treated as PossDup = Y. Reset (GapFillFlag not Y) is used only as a last resort, always by human intervention; resetting to a sequence number lower than the expected one causes an immediate logout.

Field.Name: GapFillFlag
Field.Description: Indicates that the Sequence Reset message is replacing administrative or application messages which will not be resent. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: NewSeqNo
Field.Description: New sequence number. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Message.Name: Logout
Message.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 session message. Either side may issue a Logout to gracefully close the session; the issuing side processes messages normally until it sees the Logout Acknowledgement, then breaks the TCP connection. NASDAQ OMX PSX will typically only request Logout after the scheduled end of a FIX session.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Free format text. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Message.Name: Logon
Message.Description: The Logon must be the first message sent by the subscriber after the TCP connection is established. The IP Address of the subscriber, the SenderCompId and TargetCompId will be validated; if validation fails the connection will be dropped. After an unexpected disconnect a Logon Acknowledgement with a sequence number greater than expected means in-flight messages were missed and should be retrieved with a Resend Request.

Field.Name: EncryptMethod
Field.Description: Ignored (FIX level encryption is not supported).

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Heartbeat interval in seconds. Must be specified by the subscriber in whole seconds; the accepted value is returned on the Logon Acknowledgement.

Field.Name: ResetSeqNumFlag
Field.Description: Ignored.

Field.Name: RawDataLength
Field.Description: Ignored.

Message.Name: NewOrderSingle
Message.Description: Enter Order Message. Broker Dealers who wish to electronically submit securities orders to NASDAQ OMX PSX for execution use the new order message type.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: The ClOrdId field only supports alphanumeric characters. You can put any information you like. The ID must be day-unique for each Flite account. Client order ID is limited to 14 characters.

Field.Name: HandlInst
Field.Description: If present must be 1 = Automated execution order, private, no Broker intervention.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: NASDAQ OMX PSX traded symbol.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Buy/sell indicator.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Total number of shares entered. Must be greater than zero and less than 1,000,000.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The price of the limit order. Price should be absent for OrderType = 2 (Market); if however price will be present for market orders the order will be considered as a limit with a price being a limit price. Price fields are limited to 4 places after decimal point; the maximum accepted price should not exceed 199,999.9900.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: The number of seconds that this order should live before being automatically canceled, or one of the special values.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: This field should contain all caps. Firm Identifier for the order entry firm. One logical Flite Account can potentially enter orders for multiple firms in a Service Bureau configuration. If this field is blank-filled, the default firm for the Flite Account will be used.

Field.Name: Display
Field.Description: Display type.

Field.Name: Rule80A
Field.Description: Capacity. Values other than A, P, or R will be converted to O = Other.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Valid values f (ISO) and y (Trade-at ISO). Other values from this multi-value string field will be ignored.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Specifies the minimum acceptable quantity to execute.

Field.Name: CrossType
Field.Description: Named Cross Type in the document. Cross type. Absence of this field is treated as if N was sent.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: If present must be 2 = Limit or 1 = Market Order. In former case price should be absent. If set to Market Order, then the order must participate in a crossing process (Tag 9355).

Message.Name: OrderCancelReplaceRequest
Message.Description: Replace Order Message (Order Cancel/Replace Request, a.k.a. Order Modification Request). Changes the parameters of an existing order; requests that cannot be processed are rejected with the Cancel Reject message. The only fields that can be changed are OrderQty, Price, Time in Force, Display, ISO (ExecInst) and Minimum Quantity; all other fields should be retransmitted as sent in the original order.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: This must be filled out with the exact ClOrdId sent on the Enter Order Message or last Replace Order Message.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: The ClOrdId field only supports alphanumeric characters. You can put any information you like. The ID must be day-unique for each Flite account. Client order ID is limited to 14 characters.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Buy/sell indicator.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: NASDAQ OMX PSX traded symbol.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Total number of shares liable, inclusive of previous executions on this order chain. Must be greater than zero and less than 1,000,000.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The price of the replacement order. Price should be absent for OrderType = 2 (Market); if however price will be present for market orders the order will be considered as a limit with a price being a limit price. Price fields are limited to 4 places after decimal point.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: The number of seconds that this replacement should live before being automatically canceled, or one of the special values.

Field.Name: Display
Field.Description: Display type.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Valid values f (ISO) and y (Trade-at ISO).

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Specifies the minimum acceptable quantity to execute.

Field.Name: HandlInst
Field.Description: If present must be 1 = Automated execution order, private, no Broker intervention.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: If present must be 2 = Limit or 1 = Market Order. In former case price should be absent. If set to Market Order, then the order must participate in a crossing process (Tag 9355).

Message.Name: OrderCancelRequest
Message.Description: Cancel Order Message. Requests the cancellation of all of the remaining quantity of an existing order; the Order Cancel/Replace Request should be used to partially cancel (reduce) an order. The only acknowledgement is the resulting Canceled Order Message (Execution Report); there is no too late to cancel message, and superfluous Cancel Order Messages are silently ignored.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: The Order Token as was originally transmitted in an Enter Order Message.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Buy/sell indicator.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Stock Symbol.

Message.Name: TradingSessionStatus
Message.Description: System Event Message. Signals events that affect the entire NASDAQ OMX PSX system.

Field.Name: TradSesStatus
Field.Description: Event Code.

Message.Name: ExecutionReport
Message.Description: Execution Report. Confirms the receipt of an order, confirms changes to an existing order (accepted cancel and replace requests), relays order status information and fill information on working orders, and rejects orders. Each execution message describes the current state of the order and execution status as understood by NASDAQ OMX PSX; state changes are sent as separate messages and are not used to also convey new partial fill details.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: OrderID, as assigned by NASDAQ OMX PSX, is required to be unique for each chain of orders.

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: Identifier of execution message as assigned by broker. NASDAQ OMX PSX assigns the ExecID based on the Flite match number of the transaction. If you cross yourself on a trade the buy and sell orders will have the same ExecID.

Field.Name: ExecTransType
Field.Description: Identifies transaction type. Trade breaks will be sent with an ExecTransType of 1. NASDAQ OMX PSX does not support trade corrections.

Field.Name: ExecBroker
Field.Description: INET.

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: Describes the type of execution report. Same possible values as OrdStatus.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: Describes the current state of a CHAIN of orders, same scope as OrderQty, CumQty, LeavesQty, and AvgPx.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: NASDAQ OMX PSX traded symbol.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: For rejected orders, this field is not required.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: For rejected orders, this field is not required.

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Quantity of shares bought/sold on this (last) fill.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of this (last) fill.

Field.Name: LeavesQty
Field.Description: Amount of shares open for further execution. If the OrdStatus is Canceled, DoneForTheDay, Expired, Calculated, or Rejected (in which case the order is no longer active) then LeavesQty could be 0, otherwise LeavesQty = OrderQty - CumQty. For rejected orders, this field is not required.

Field.Name: CumQty
Field.Description: Currently executed shares for chain of orders.

Field.Name: AvgPx
Field.Description: Calculated average price of all fills on this order.

Field.Name: ExecRefID
Field.Description: Appears on Breaks only and contains the ExecID of the trade being broken.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdId of the order being reported.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: As specified in the NewOrder.

Field.Name: PegDifference
Field.Description: As specified in the NewOrder.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the previous order (NOT the initial order of the day) when reporting replace.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: Used for firm identification in third-party transactions. If a ClientID was specified in the original order then it will be returned in all subsequent execution reports.

Field.Name: Display
Field.Description: Display type as specified on the order.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Absence of this field indicates Market Hours order.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of execution/order creation (expressed in GMT).

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Free format text string. In case of reject will also contain NASDAQ OMX PSX order reject code. Reject Reasons: T = Test Mode, the Flite Account is configured for test mode and cannot accept orders in non-TEST securities; H = Halted; Z = Shares exceeds configured safety threshold; S = Invalid stock; D = Invalid Display Type; C = NASDAQ OMX PSX is closed; L = Requested firm not authorized for requested clearing type on this account; M = Outside of permitted times for requested clearing type; R = This order is not allowed in this type of cross (stock or time restrictions); X = Invalid price; N = Invalid Minimum Quantity; W = Invalid Mid-point Post Only Price.

Field.Name: LiquidityFlag
Field.Description: Will be returned within all execution reports that contain a partial or full fill.

Field.Name: BBOWeightIndicator
Field.Description: Named BBO Weight indicator in the document. BBO weight indicator. Space = unspecified.

Message.Name: OrderCancelReject
Message.Description: Order Cancel Reject. Issued by NASDAQ OMX PSX upon receipt of a Cancel Request or Cancel/Replace Request Message that cannot be honored.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: If the cancel reject is for an unknown order this field will contain the text Unknown. Otherwise, it will contain the OrderID of the last order in the chain of orders.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique order id assigned by broker to the cancel request or to the replacement order. As of now this is not supported and will not be specified; CancelReject will contain only OrigClOrdId.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID that could not be canceled/replaced. ClOrdID of the previous order (NOT the initial order of the day) when canceling or replacing an order.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: OrdStatus value after this cancel reject is applied.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: Used for firm identification in third-party transactions. For known orders this will contain the ClientID specified in the original order.

Field.Name: CxlRejReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for cancel rejection.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: See Reject Reasons table.
